event.decision_instant: tip + 75 min (tip = the listing's occurrence_datetime minus 3 h (schedule-shaped proxy, truth unproven; the PREDRIFT1 schedule test applies, NFL weaker)); quote = the last two-sided poll within the 5 minutes before

kill: 2c PF under 1.0 on the first read (kill_fast), or under 100 games by 2026-12-15
